reply_text:
Gist: Fixed: `r` in the stepper and `R` in the rewind view now work in your Emacs. Don't practise `R` on the frames available right now, because it would revert real work. The stepper's newest frame is your "I'd not mark them" turn, whose signed commit 3981fb38 contains the signing hook and `R` itself, and this turn's commit is the keymap fix. For a safe practice, send one more turn asking for a practice commit. I'll make a single signed commit that only adds a scratch file, and you can rewind that turn with `r` then `R`.

**What was wrong:** both keymaps were created the first time the file loaded in your Emacs. A reload doesn't replace a keymap that already exists, so the keys I added later never reached you. My tests start from a fresh Emacs, so they couldn't see this. The keys are now bound outside those definitions, so every reload applies them. A new test simulates a keymap left over from an old load; it fails on the previous version. Committed as 1253a8cc; 21 stepper tests pass.

**Your "just say hi" turn:** it isn't in the stepper yet, because 象 hasn't finished reading it. It also made no commits, so `r` on it will say there's nothing to rewind in git.
